name: multi_asset_signal_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY/BANKNIFTY, when spot rises for 2 minutes while India VIX simultaneously rises, large institutions are buying protective puts against their long equity exposure even as futures tick higher — internal conflict between directional flow and hedging flow that resolves within 30-90 seconds as the hedge-buying overwhelms the bid and pulls the index down. The reverse pattern (spot falling, VIX also falling) is complacent retail stop-loss selling without institutional panic: resting buy orders from VWAP-benchmarked algorithms absorb the selling and snap the index back up within 60 seconds. This 'same-direction' NIFTY/VIX co-movement is statistically unusual (normal regime is negative correlation: index up, VIX down) and signals the divergence will resolve back toward the expected negative relationship.
core_signal_oneliner: 2-minute NIFTY spot and VIX moving in the same direction (abnormal correlation), indicating an unstable institutional hedging divergence that will snap back within 30-90 seconds
